summary: GenerateCourse is a web user control for generating course-related correspondence, including recipient lists and formatted letters, with detailed filtering and workflow for administrators, coordinators, and instructors.
purpose: To facilitate creation and management of course correspondence, recipient lists, and formal letters for courses/cohorts, providing flexible selection, filtering, and output format options for authorized users within an educational placement system.

workflows.name: Initialize and Bind Controls
steps: Page_Load: Detect if CohortID and CourseID are present; set up appropriate UI changes; initialize CorrespondenceRecipientsPopup.
Page_PreRender: Setup JavaScript variables for UI behavior; reset txtRequestDestID.
DataBind: Fill department, program, term, choosers, and date source dropdowns; initialize glossary/help links.

workflows.name: User Input and Filtering
steps: User selects department, program, term, filters (status, dates, recipients); system populates dropdowns accordingly.
User selects output format (PDF, MultiPDF, RTF, XLS, TXT, LABEL).
User chooses addressee/contact options, signatory, and other correspondence options.
System validates input data (recipient list, date, status selection).

workflows.name: Save and Prepare Correspondence Variables
steps: SaveRunVariables: Validate all selections, dates, filters, checkboxes; populate Hashtable 'data' with each option.
If Outbox and valid recipient list, include OutboxPRsIncluded.
Handle program/term/cohort/course filtering for correspondence.
Set OutputFormat and other flags (CCs, logos, department address, separate student pages, etc).
Determine SignatoryID and handle custom signature logic.
Iterate through options and persist them via CorrespondenceRunVariablesAdd.

workflows.name: Generate Correspondence Output
steps: On cmdGerenate_Click: Use current TimeStamp and OutputFormat; run SaveRunVariables; clear certain checkboxes after successful save.
Determine user role for correspondence context (PC, DC, RC).
Build correspondence recipient popup URL with relevant parameters.
Open recipient popup for final selection/confirmation.

workflows.name: Dropdown Change Handling
steps: Each dropdown change (department, program, term) triggers re-population of dependent dropdowns and choosers.
Date source dropdown change updates correspondence date logic.
Status and signatory dropdowns load based on user context and previous selections.

business_rules: Recipient list must be valid and not empty ('-1' or null triggers error).
Date must be valid; invalid dates trigger error.
Certain fields only enabled or visible depending on user role and system settings.
Cohort/Course ID presence disables manual selection.
ProgramID and TermID are required if not Outbox.
If Outbox, dates may be auto-selected from session variables.
CorrespondenceDate format respects alternate language fields.
Scheduled correspondence is flagged if date source is PR Dates with appropriate context.
validations: Recipient List: Must not be '-1' or empty.
Date: Must match expected format and not be null.
Status: At least one status must be selected if required.
Dropdown dependencies: Program and term selections must cascade properly.
Checkboxes: Proper dependency (e.g., addressee/contact info only if not blank addressee).
calculations: Dates for Outbox correspondence use session and constant values, with possible custom ranges.
CorrespondenceDate formatted differently depending on UseAltLanguageFields (French or English format).
CoursesIncluded constructed from either query parameters or included list.
conditions: If Outbox is true, recipient logic and date selection differ.
If FormalLetter is true, signature and custom fields populate differently.
If CohortID and CourseID are provided, user cannot change included courses.
Dropdowns enabled/disabled based on query parameters and context.
Status filter included only if specified.
system_behavior: UI populates, enables/disables controls based on user session and query parameters.
System validates, saves, and persists correspondence variables.
Handles JavaScript registration for UI variables on pre-render.
Clears and resets fields after correspondence generation.
dependencies: Dropdown controls for department, program, term, signatory
exceptions: Invalid recipient list triggers error message.
Dropdowns fail to populate if session or required data is missing.
Scheduled correspondence not possible if date source missing or invalid.
